title: Centered Boolean word identity
statement: For any type $\Gamma$, function $f:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to\Gamma$, and natural number $s$, mapping $f$ over the list obtained by applying $f$ to the Boolean test that $j=s$, for $j=0,\ldots,2s$, gives the same list as mapping $f$ over $s$ false values, followed by true, followed by $s$ false values.
